scope: Engineering motor diagnosis within the current recovery step. Not native-agent evidence, experience-reuse evaluation, held-out tests or new-geometry transfer.

historical_findings.native: Both completed lift/turn but not whole-task withdrawal. Attempt001 crossed the unchanged 2mm penetration stop; attempt002 stayed within limits but exhausted 64 decisions.
historical_findings.controlled_free_space: Identical first seven reference actions/states. Same fixed head target: nominal error17.227mm vs command-feedback0.916mm.
historical_findings.contact: Instantaneous, fixed-free-space and hybrid bias approaches have not completed the fixed-program insertion probe. No full-task motor repair is yet accepted.

new_diagnostic_method: Fresh public WrenchRuntime seed5; replay only saved robot actions through an original pre-withdrawal prefix, independently compare the endpoint with the original request, then test measured tool/nut-frame recovery. Never reset a live object's state.
frozen_physics: Panda/Shadow assets, wrench/nut geometry, mass, contact/friction, gains, task evaluator and quality thresholds stay unchanged.

quality.first_breach: retain sample and interrupted action, then terminate as failure

budget_accounting: Includes five completed motor probes, one root-owned targeted prefix diagnostic and at most six independent solver-lane probes. Every failure and source version is retained.
resources: Local headless CPU only, independent models/outputs per lane. No original Isaac launch, remote workstation, DeepSeek or other helper API. New runtime evidence remains under the initial 2GB ceiling.
acceptance: A repaired local primitive needs actual independent physical gates, quality pass and an accepted finish. This only validates an engineering primitive; a fresh native actor must subsequently demonstrate same-episode correction and whole task before step3 begins.
provenance: Save exact controller/probe source, metadata, prefix command hashes and endpoint comparison, every command/result/observation, 500Hz raw samples and independent evaluator results. Distinguish code error, convergence failure, quality stop and physical task failure. No post-hoc relabeling of earlier attempts.
later_steps: Fresh-agent experience reuse, reserved placement and a different wrench remain unstarted.
